tasks.label: Build Active C File
tasks.command: if [[ "${fileExtname}" != ".c" ]]; then echo "Error: '${fileBasename}' is not a C source file (.c)"; exit 1; fi && mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/bin" && rm -f "${workspaceFolder}/bin/${fileBasenameNoExtension}" && clang -g -Wall -Wextra "${file}" -o "${workspaceFolder}/bin/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"

tasks.label: Run Active C File
tasks.command: if [[ "${fileExtname}" != ".c" ]]; then echo "Error: '${fileBasename}' is not a C source file (.c)"; exit 1; fi && "${workspaceFolder}/bin/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"

tasks.label: Build Active C++ File
tasks.command: if [[ "${fileExtname}" != ".cpp" && "${fileExtname}" != ".cc" && "${fileExtname}" != ".cxx" ]]; then echo "Error: '${fileBasename}' is not a C++ source file (.cpp/.cc/.cxx)"; exit 1; fi && mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/bin" && rm -f "${workspaceFolder}/bin/${fileBasenameNoExtension}" && clang++ -std=c++17 -g -Wall -Wextra "${file}" -o "${workspaceFolder}/bin/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"

tasks.label: Run Active C++ File
tasks.command: if [[ "${fileExtname}" != ".cpp" && "${fileExtname}" != ".cc" && "${fileExtname}" != ".cxx" ]]; then echo "Error: '${fileBasename}' is not a C++ source file (.cpp/.cc/.cxx)"; exit 1; fi && "${workspaceFolder}/bin/${fileBasenameNoExtension}"

tasks.label: Run Active Python File
tasks.command: if [[ "${fileExtname}" != ".py" ]]; then echo "Error: '${fileBasename}' is not a Python source file (.py)"; exit 1; fi && /usr/bin/python3 -u "${file}"

tasks.label: Build Active Java File
tasks.command: if [[ "${fileExtname}" != ".java" ]]; then echo "Error: '${fileBasename}' is not a Java source file (.java)"; exit 1; fi && mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/bin" && rm -f "${workspaceFolder}/bin/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.class" && /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin/javac -g -d "${workspaceFolder}/bin" "${file}"

tasks.label: Run Active Java File
tasks.command: if [[ "${fileExtname}" != ".java" ]]; then echo "Error: '${fileBasename}' is not a Java source file (.java)"; exit 1; fi && /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin/java -cp "${workspaceFolder}/bin" "${fileBasenameNoExtension}"
